title: NMMA fits for SN 2021ugl (NMMA-Astro-COLIBRI paper)
description: Nested-sampling posteriors, best-fit parameters, and figures for all four analysis configurations (early-time / full-baseline, with / without upper limits) used in the Results section of 'NMMA-Astro-COLIBRI: An Automated Light-Curve Classification Service for Supernovae in the Multi-Survey Era', together with the scripts needed to reproduce them.
